name: threesmith
description: Makes Claude Code better at three.js: the API of your installed three version, a scored review pinned to it (98 rules incl. shaders and R3F), asset and decoder checks, the page run headless with the live scene read back, play with claims, perf and leak checks, build checks, and 3D models built without Blender. Reviews every three.js file Claude edits, with skills for debugging, performance, upgrades, shipping and models.

project.title: three.js project
project.description: The folder with the project's package.json (and node_modules/three). Tools use it when Claude does not pass a path. Empty: the folder Claude Code runs in.

protect.title: Protected paths (optional)
protect.description: Folders or files that must stay byte-identical, separated by commas: Claude's file edits and Threesmith's writes refuse them. Absolute, or relative to the folder Claude Code runs in. A threesmith.json "protect" list does the same per project.

tools.title: Tool sets (optional)
tools.description: Which Threesmith tools Claude sees, comma separated: core, run, live, build, model, or tool names. Empty means all 31.

read_only.title: Read-only
read_only.description: Leave out the tools that always write and refuse write options on the others (dry runs still work).
